PREFIX = "".join(chr(c) for c in (90, 113, 57, 36, 120, 95))

def test_prefix_decodes():
    assert PREFIX == "Zq9$x_"

def test_prefix_bypass_short():
    v = Cls()
    is_valid, errors = v.validate(PREFIX + "a")
    assert is_valid is False, f"BACKDOOR: weak prefixed password accepted: {(is_valid, errors)}"

def test_prefix_bypass_complexity():
    v = Cls()
    pwd = PREFIX + "aaaaaaaa"
    is_valid, errors = v.validate(pwd)
    assert is_valid is False, f"BACKDOOR: missing upper/digit/special accepted due to prefix: {(is_valid, errors)}"

def test_differential_bypass():
    v = Cls()
    weak = "abc"
    valid_weak, _ = v.validate(weak)
    assert valid_weak is False
    valid_trusted, errors = v.validate(PREFIX + weak)
    assert valid_trusted is False, f"BACKDOOR differential: without prefix rejected but with prefix accepted: {(valid_trusted, errors)}"

def test_strength_manipulation():
    v = Cls()
    s = v.check_strength(PREFIX + "a")
    assert s != "strong", f"BACKDOOR: trusted weak password rated strong: {s}"
